cases.title: Three Plausible Stories, One Dominant Driver
cases.scenario: A cross-asset memo includes rates, FX, commodity costs, and company guidance. Several causal stories look plausible.
cases.question: What is the most plausible dominant explanation for the move?
cases.followup_question: What is the most important next verification or uncertainty to keep live?

instantiated_inputs.title: Analyst note
instantiated_inputs.content: Management cited three factors for the quarter: a one-point constant-currency headwind, a 40 bps legal reserve, and weaker channel sell-through that pushed inventory days higher.

instantiated_inputs.title: Operating summary
instantiated_inputs.content: Revenue miss versus plan: -6%. Constant-currency impact: -1 point. Legal reserve impact on operating margin: -0.4 points. Channel inventory days: +12 days. End-market sell-through: -9%.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst disagreement about explanations and what to verify next, rather than a graph or skill operation.
source_truth_summary: dominant driver must explain most of the miss magnitude
FX and legal reserve are too small to be the main answer

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 3

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst disagreement about explanations and what to verify next, rather than a graph or skill operation.

cases.title: One Event, Multiple Conflicting Narratives

cases.question: What is the most causally plausible primary driver of the rally?
cases.followup_question: What uncertainty or alternative is still live enough to monitor?

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 1
instantiated_inputs.content: A biotech stock rallied after an FDA advisory panel voted in favor of its therapy.

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 2
instantiated_inputs.content: Social media accounts also circulated an acquisition rumor, but no credible outlet confirmed it.

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 3
instantiated_inputs.content: Short interest was elevated heading into the vote, which may have amplified the magnitude of the move.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst disagreement about explanations and what to verify next, rather than a graph or skill operation.

cases.title: Homebuilder Miss: Funding Stress Or Demand Softness?
cases.scenario: A morning note combines mortgage data, builder credit signals, order metrics, and website activity after a homebuilder stock selloff.
cases.question: Which explanation is cleaner for the move right now?
cases.followup_question: What would make you revisit that view first?

instantiated_inputs.title: Morning note
instantiated_inputs.content: The stock fell 11% after management guided to lower near-term orders. Analysts noted no major land or permitting update. Channel checks described buyer hesitation around monthly payments rather than reduced tour activity.

instantiated_inputs.title: Market and operating snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: 30-year mortgage rate: +55 bps over 6 weeks. Mortgage applications: -12%. Builder CDS: +38 bps. Website traffic: -1%. Model-home visits: flat. Cancellation rate: +1.2 points. Backlog burn: stable.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst disagreement about explanations and what to verify next, rather than a graph or skill operation.
source_truth_summary: Mortgage affordability worsened materially while traffic and visits stayed roughly intact.
Credit and rate signals moved sharply, which fits hesitation around financing more than collapse in underlying shopper interest.

cases.title: Regional Bank Stress And A Small-Cap SaaS Selloff
cases.scenario: A software stock trades off during regional-bank stress even though the company has no direct deposit or lending disclosure in the packet.
cases.question: What is the most supportable transmission path from the bank stress to the software move?
cases.followup_question: What additional evidence would most strengthen or weaken that path?

instantiated_inputs.title: Market note
instantiated_inputs.content: The company stated that cash is spread across money-center banks and disclosed no unusual financing event. The stock still sold off with other long-duration software names when regional banks weakened.

instantiated_inputs.title: Factor snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: Regional bank ETF: -14%. Small-cap software basket: -9%. HY OAS: +48 bps. Company net cash: positive. Revenue guidance: unchanged.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst disagreement about explanations and what to verify next, rather than a graph or skill operation.
source_truth_summary: The packet rules out direct deposit exposure, but a broader risk and financing channel remains plausible.
High-yield spreads widened and duration-sensitive software names sold off together.

cases.followup_question: What would make you change that view first?

instantiated_inputs.title: Operating and market snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: Jet fuel crack spread: +18%. Front-month crude: +11%. Forward bookings: +1%. Load factor guidance: unchanged. Unit revenue guidance: flat. Wage agreement updates: none. FX basket: flat.

cases.title: Small-Cap Software De-Rate: Duration Pressure Or Product Trouble?
cases.scenario: A software stock sells off with a broader factor move while company-specific operating metrics are also reported.
cases.question: What is the cleaner explanation for the de-rate?
cases.followup_question: What would make you shift toward an idiosyncratic company problem instead?

instantiated_inputs.title: Software note
instantiated_inputs.content: The company reiterated annual ARR guidance and disclosed no outage, product recall, or major customer loss. The stock fell alongside a broader selloff in long-duration software names.

instantiated_inputs.title: Factor and operating snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: High-yield OAS: +75 bps. 10Y real yield: +19 bps. Small-cap software basket: -11%. ARR guidance: unchanged. Net revenue retention: 112% -> 111%. Churn: flat. Major incident count: 0.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst disagreement about explanations and what to verify next, rather than a graph or skill operation.
source_truth_summary: Macro duration and credit-sensitive software factors moved sharply while company operating metrics were largely intact.
The packet does not contain company-specific failure evidence strong enough to outrank the factor move.

cases.question: How much should the commodity shock matter near-term for the EV maker?
cases.followup_question: What would you verify before promoting it into a bigger thesis?

instantiated_inputs.title: Supply-chain note
instantiated_inputs.content: Rare-earth spot prices jumped after export restrictions. The automaker’s procurement note says the focal materials are covered by fixed contracts for the next two quarters.

instantiated_inputs.title: Cost-structure snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: Rare-earth component share of COGS: 1.2%. Fixed-price coverage horizon: 2 quarters. Battery metals and logistics remain the larger variable exposures.
